title: Apex Production Network Topology — VLAN Segmentation and Firewall Architecture

<text x="405" y="358" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Inference API</text>
<rect x="490" y="314" width="130" height="52" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="555" y="333" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">Kafka (3x)</text>

<text x="555" y="358" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">TCP 9092 SASL/SSL</text>
<rect x="640" y="314" width="100" height="52" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="690" y="333" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">MinIO S3</text>
<text x="690" y="346" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Snapshots</text>
<text x="690" y="358" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Audit logs</text>
<!-- IoT / VLAN 400 -->
<rect x="20" y="396" width="360" height="60" rx="8" fill="#FBEAF0" stroke="#F04E98" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="30" y="414" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#F04E98">IoT — VLAN 400 (Isolated)</text>
<rect x="40" y="420" width="140" height="28" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#F04E98" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="110" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#F04E98">MQTT Mosquitto (3x)</text>
<rect x="200" y="420" width="140" height="28" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#F04E98" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="270" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#F04E98">100x IoT Edge Nodes</text>
<!-- K8s / VLAN 500 -->
<rect x="400" y="396" width="360" height="60" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#888" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="410" y="414" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#555">Kubernetes — VLAN 500</text>
<rect x="420" y="420" width="140" height="28" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="490" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#555">k8s-es-prod</text>
<rect x="580" y="420" width="140" height="28" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="650" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#555">k8s-infra</text>
<!-- Corporate / VLAN 600 -->
<rect x="20" y="474" width="740" height="50" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="30" y="492" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#888">Corporate — VLAN 600 (No data tier access)</text>
<text x="30" y="510" font-size="9" fill="#aaa">Workstations · VDI · Azure AD SSO → Kibana only (via HAProxy / VLAN 100) · No direct ES API access</text>
<!-- Inter-tier arrows -->
<line x1="390" y1="80" x2="390" y2="98" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<line x1="170" y1="154" x2="170" y2="210" stroke="#FEC514" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<line x1="520" y1="260" x2="520" y2="290" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<line x1="270" y1="456" x2="380" y2="290" stroke="#F04E98" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<!-- Firewall labels -->
<rect x="340" y="172" width="100" height="16" rx="3" fill="#CC0000"/>
<text x="390" y="183" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" font-weight="bold" fill="white">FIREWALL (Cisco ASA)</text>
<rect x="340" y="278" width="100" height="16" rx="3" fill="#CC0000"/>
<text x="390" y="289" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" font-weight="bold" fill="white">FIREWALL (strict whitelist)</text>
</svg>
description_text: Network topology diagram showing VLAN segmentation across the Frankfurt production datacenter: VLAN 10 (management), VLAN 100 DMZ frontend (HAProxy, F5, Cloudflare WAF), VLAN 200 application tier (AFDS, Maya, Logstash, ES coordinating, Vault), VLAN 300 data tier (ES hot/warm/ML, Kafka, MinIO — isolated, strict whitelist), VLAN 400 IoT (MQTT, 100 edge nodes), VLAN 500 Kubernetes, VLAN 600 corporate (no data tier access). Cisco Nexus 9000 core with 100 Gbps uplinks, MPLS dual-circuit WAN.

<text x="390" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">All changes via GitOps — no manual kubectl apply on production. Rollback: ArgoCD → previous Git commit (<5min).</text>

description_text: Kubernetes workload architecture for k8s-es-prod cluster showing ECK-managed Elasticsearch StatefulSets (masters 3x, hot data 6x, ML GPU 2x, warm 2x, coordinating+Kibana), Logstash Deployments (TXN, IoT, INT/ITKB pipelines), Kafka StatefulSets (3 brokers, KRaft mode), and GitOps deployment flow via ArgoCD (GitHub Actions CI → merge → ArgoCD sync → k8s apply, rollback < 5 minutes).

<rect x="0" y="0" width="780" height="36" fill="#0B64DD"/>
<text x="390" y="23" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="white">Apex Platform CI/CD Pipeline — GitHub Actions + ArgoCD</text>
<!-- Stage boxes -->
<rect x="10" y="52" width="115" height="108" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="67" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">1. Code</text>
<text x="67" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Commit</text>
<text x="67" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Developer PR</text>
<text x="67" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">ops-platform</text>
<text x="67" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Branch: feature/*</text>
<text x="67" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Trigger: PR open</text>
<line x1="125" y1="106" x2="148" y2="106" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="148" y="52" width="115" height="108" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">2. Lint +</text>
<text x="205" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Validate</text>
<text x="205" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">yamllint</text>
<text x="205" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">ES mapping JSON schema</text>
<text x="205" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Logstash --config.test</text>
<text x="205" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Duration: ~2min</text>
<line x1="263" y1="106" x2="286" y2="106" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="286" y="52" width="115" height="108" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="343" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">3. Unit +</text>
<text x="343" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Integration</text>
<text x="343" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Logstash filter tests</text>
<text x="343" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">ES mapping tests</text>
<text x="343" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Prometheus rule tests</text>
<text x="343" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Duration: ~8min</text>
<line x1="401" y1="106" x2="424" y2="106" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="424" y="52" width="115" height="108" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="481" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">4. Security</text>
<text x="481" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Scan</text>
<text x="481" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Trivy image scan</text>
<text x="481" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">git-secrets detect</text>
<text x="481" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">OPA Gatekeeper policy</text>
<text x="481" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Duration: ~4min</text>
<line x1="539" y1="106" x2="562" y2="106" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="562" y="52" width="115" height="108" rx="8" fill="#E1F5EE" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="619" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">5. Staging</text>
<text x="619" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">Deploy + Smoke</text>
<text x="619" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">k8s-es-staging</text>
<text x="619" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">10 golden queries</text>
<text x="619" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">per language (5 langs)</text>
<text x="619" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">Duration: ~12min</text>
<line x1="677" y1="106" x2="700" y2="106" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#b)"/>
<rect x="700" y="52" width="70" height="108" rx="8" fill="#48EFCF" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="735" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">6. PR</text>
<text x="735" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">Merge</text>
<text x="735" y="122" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#0F6E56">2 approvals</text>
<text x="735" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#0F6E56">required</text>
<!-- Failure paths -->
<rect x="190" y="185" width="80" height="22" rx="4" fill="#FFEEEE" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="230" y="199" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#CC0000">FAIL → Block PR</text>
<line x1="205" y1="160" x2="205" y2="185" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
<rect x="328" y="185" width="80" height="22" rx="4" fill="#FFEEEE" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="368" y="199" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#CC0000">FAIL → Block PR</text>
<line x1="343" y1="160" x2="343" y2="185" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
<rect x="466" y="185" width="80" height="22" rx="4" fill="#FFEEEE" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="506" y="199" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#CC0000">Critical CVE → Block</text>
<line x1="481" y1="160" x2="481" y2="185" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
<!-- ArgoCD CD section -->
<rect x="10" y="230" width="760" height="88" rx="8" fill="#E8F0FE" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="20" y="248" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Continuous Deployment — ArgoCD (post-merge to main)</text>
<rect x="30" y="258" width="130" height="48" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="95" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">Auto-sync (safe changes)</text>
<text x="95" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">ILM policies · Kibana dashboards</text>
<text x="95" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Logstash filter updates</text>
<line x1="160" y1="282" x2="188" y2="282" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="188" y="258" width="130" height="48" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#FEC514" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="253" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#B8860B">Manual sync (risky)</text>
<text x="253" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Node pool changes</text>
<text x="253" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">ILM policy delete phase</text>
<line x1="318" y1="282" x2="346" y2="282" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/>
<rect x="346" y="258" width="140" height="48" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#F04E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="416" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#F04E98">Canary Rollout (models)</text>
<text x="416" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">10% → metric check</text>
<text x="416" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">→ 50% → 100% (AFDS)</text>
<rect x="576" y="258" width="175" height="48" rx="5" fill="#48EFCF" stroke="#0F6E56" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="663" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F6E56">Rollback (1-click)</text>
<text x="663" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#0F6E56">ArgoCD → previous Git commit</text>
<text x="663" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#0F6E56">SLA: <5 minutes</text>
<!-- Metrics -->
<rect x="10" y="332" width="760" height="95" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#ddd"/>
<text x="390" y="350" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#333">Pipeline Performance Metrics (2024 average)</text>
<rect x="30" y="360" width="160" height="55" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#0B64DD"/>
<text x="110" y="382" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">26min</text>
<text x="110" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">average full pipeline duration</text>
<text x="110" y="415" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">(lint to staging smoke test)</text>
<rect x="210" y="360" width="160" height="55" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#0B64DD"/>
<text x="290" y="382" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">97.3%</text>
<text x="290" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">pipeline success rate (2024)</text>
<text x="290" y="415" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">347 runs, 9 failed (all reverted)</text>
<rect x="390" y="360" width="160" height="55" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#48EFCF"/>
<text x="470" y="382" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">4.8min</text>
<text x="470" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">average ArgoCD rollback time</text>
<text x="470" y="415" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">SLA target: <5 minutes</text>
<rect x="570" y="360" width="180" height="55" rx="4" fill="white" stroke="#48EFCF"/>
<text x="660" y="382" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0B64DD">0</text>
<text x="660" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">production outages caused by CD</text>
<text x="660" y="415" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#888">GitOps rollback prevented all 9 failures</text>
</svg>
description_text: CI/CD pipeline architecture showing 6 stages: code commit, lint+validate (yamllint, ES JSON schema, Logstash test), unit+integration tests, security scan (Trivy, git-secrets, OPA), staging deploy + smoke tests (10 golden queries x 5 languages), PR merge. CD via ArgoCD: auto-sync for safe changes, manual sync for risky, canary rollout for AFDS models (10%→50%→100%), 1-click rollback in < 5 minutes. 2024 stats: 97.3% pipeline success rate, 26min average duration, 0 production outages from CD.
